title: Archi bundle manifest (bundle.yaml)
description: A named, versioned selection of packs plus a chat preset and an eval set (ADR 0002 section 3.2). Paths are relative to the directory holding bundle.yaml.

name.description: Bundle name. Must equal the directory name.

extends.description: Bundles whose default packs this one inherits, resolved transitively.

optional.description: Packs offered for --with. Not installed unless asked for.

companions.description: Packs that come on whenever another pack is selected, {<pack>: [<companion>, ...]} (ADR 0002 section 3.3, amended 2026-10-31). When <pack> is selected, by default or with --with, each companion is added with the packs it requires, unless it is removed with --without. Merged over extends, parents first.

chat.description: Chat preset. Scalars come from the last --bundle given; suggestions are a union.

automations.description: Upper bound on the autonomy level of each automation pack this bundle selects, {<automation>: {max_level}}. The instance sets the level itself, in archi.yaml, and may not exceed any bound. L0, L1 or L2; anything above L2 is refused (ADR 0002 D13).

answers.description: Install-question defaults this bundle sets, {<rendered question id>: value}, e.g. analysis_notes_min_notes. A later bundle overrides an earlier one; an id no selected pack asks is refused.

eval.description: Eval set (JSONL) run by `archi eval` and by CI.

okg.description: Supported AKMON (okg) version range, PEP 440 specifiers, e.g. ">=0.2.0,<0.3".
